name: Kylin
source:
A spider who works for Ma Wen.
In the Web assassin school, he is the same generation as Ding Xiu and can handle any weapon without any difficulty.
He participated in the battle for Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion, and worked with Yvet and others to reach the top floor.
Many of the graduates of the Web assassin school are dressed in eccentric outfits, such as dyed hair like Yuchi and Jack, or red wigs like Lycoris, but he is also quite a fashionable guy.
